The dream-monsters were best fought with weapons that struck down the spirit, rather than the flesh. | crafting = Stormreaver Monument{{Extra|2|Dreamforge}} | craftingupgrade = | pic = Dreamspitter shown.jpg | picdesc = Dreamspitter.png | tips =
* Pre U12 versions missing Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) can have this added via the Stormreaver Monument with 5 Ancient Elven Relics. Existing upgrades (Holy, Force Damage Ritual, etc.) are maintained. * Some old versions of the Dreamspitter do not have the Suppressed Power. This cannot be added, but you can add Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) and then Force Burst. * The negative levels inflicted by a critical hit from Dreamspitter reduce the victim's saving throws, and that effect stacks with itself. * Dreamspitter becomes Bound to Character once the suppressed power is unlocked, but remains Bound to Account when the Stormreaver Seal upgrade is applied. With the application of the [[Seal of the Stormreaver]] and a [[Crystal Disk of Dreams]], this weapon can be upgraded to: [[File:Dreamspitter (upgraded).png|center|Upgraded & Unsuppressed Version]] }} [[C:Eleven Year Old Cake items]] [[Category:Draconic Raider's Reward Box items]]

enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Greater Evil Outsider Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Evil Outsiders, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +4 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 3 to 18 points of damage against the foe.
Life Stealing: This weapon has a chance to drain 1 to 3 levels from its target on a critical hit.
Enchantment Focus II: +2 Equipment bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Suppressed Power: This psionic item is powerful, but you sense that it has not unlocked all of its secrets to you at this time.

children.tooltip: Holy: A holy weapon is imbued with holy power. This power makes the weapon good-aligned. Evil characters wielding this weapon suffer a negative level. The weapon deals an extra 2 to 12 damage against all targets of evil alignment.

children.text: Becomes Bound to Character on Acquire

enchantments.tooltip: Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver): This item could be upgraded if you found a Seal of the Stormreaver to combine it with. Bring this item to the Stormreaver Monument in Gianthold and combine it with a Seal of the Stormreaver to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

children.tooltip: Force Burst: This weapon is humming with magical force, and does 1 to 6 force damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 force damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
